purpose: Where every identifier in content/m1 comes from. Nothing in this directory invents a concept id, a standard code, or a naming scheme; this file is the receipt for that.

registry.authority: Canonical. That package exists specifically because this repository accumulated at least eight incompatible curriculum vocabularies, and content authored against anything else becomes the ninth.
registry.notOwnedHere: This content pass does not edit the registry. Where M1 content implies a registry change, it is recorded under `followUps` below rather than made.

externalCorroboration.note: Not a source of ids, but worth recording next to them: all three concepts sit under 8.4(A), and content/staar establishes that TEA has published six released 8.4(A) items plus a scored short constructed response on the same standard. The 2023 rubric bullet 'All colonists had to pay taxes on documents and paper' is TEA's own statement of the stamp-scope proposition, and the twelve scored student responses in content/staar/eval are where this bank's grading line is calibrated from.
externalCorroboration.readOnly: content/staar is another agent's directory. Nothing here modifies it.
